simple.meaning: דֶּלֶת (deleth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “something swinging , i.e. the valve of a door.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 89 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 17 more, beginning at Genesis 19:6. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דֶּלֶת (H1817).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: דֶּלֶת (deleth) / H1817 is traced through Genesis 19:6, Genesis 19:9, Genesis 19:10, Exodus 21:6 as a generated source-based concept entry.
